question: Listen up! As I was slipping on my favorite briefs after today's bath, I suddenly realized that I don't have a shadow! When did it get taken away? What kind of mario could my shadow have been put into? Please ask Moria for me. Thanks! by Iwashi-chan
answer: Who was it, Moria-san? Moria: Kishishishishi! Shut the hell up! Tell him yourself!! O: Okay. I found him for you. It's him on the right. He got lectured by Luffy.
name: Iwashi-chan
